wikipedia.pt: Referendo à despenalização do aborto em Portugal (1998)

sources.locator: "Referendo à despenalização do aborto em Portugal (1998)", revision 70878983

title: 1998 Portuguese abortion referendum
summary: The first referendum held in Portugal under the constitution asked on 28 June 1998 whether abortion on the woman's request up to ten weeks should cease to be a crime. The no won by about fifty-one to forty-nine, and turnout was under a third, so the result was not binding on the Assembly; the law that had prompted the referendum was dropped and the criminal provision stayed as it was. It is in the atlas as the first use of an instrument the constitutional revision of 1989 had created, as a question the party system could not settle inside the Assembly, and because the same question was put again nine years later and answered the other way.
